name: Integrative Pathobiology PhD
detailsNote: Central 2027–28 December 1 deadline confirmed. Earlier department March 1 space cutoff is undated and is qualified separately. Funding conditions depend on offer.

documents: Academic transcripts from every college-level institution

english.toefl: 80 before January 21, 2026; 4.5 for tests on/after that date
english.note: Two-year scores; no MyBest or IELTS One Skill Retake. DET only when other exams unavailable; DET-only admits take TOEP. English-only US degree or foreign degree with sole English instruction recorded in WHED may exempt; other documentation not accepted. Programs/TA employment may set higher standards.

applicationFee.note: US applicants$135. Central waiver limited to listed graduate-preparation programs, not general financial need. Identify program/coordinator in application; participation verified. International applicants should confirm category eligibility. Historical GGIP Equity fee fellowship is domestic-only and not confirmed for current cycle.

requirements.note: Cell biology background and equivalents of STA 100 Applied Statistics and BIS 104 Regulation of Cell Function. CV required. Two five-week rotations during funded first quarter; expected lab placement by winter.

deadlines.label: General and fellowship
deadlines.note: Current 2027–28 central table; follow earlier department closing rules.

funding.note: Entering PhDs receive first-quarter rotation funding, living allowance, full tuition/fees and nonresident supplement when applicable. International applicants should seek home-country fellowship support; only exceptional unsupported international students accepted. Contact coordinator before applying.

publishedDeadlines.label: Department space-available cutoff
publishedDeadlines.note: Undated department review window ends March 1, earlier than central June 1 space date; confirm intended cycle.
